what: Five-slot card carousel — one center card (1x), two side cards (.8x, 55% of card width), and two outer cards (.6x, 104%) stand overlapping. Pressing prev or next moves the four cards one slot over .8s power3.inOut (the leaving card goes to 110% · .6x), while the cards tilt 8° toward the direction of travel (.5s power2.inOut) and then straighten (.3s power2.out). After moving, the end card is sent back to the opposite end so it loops endlessly. Only the center card is clickable

options.[data-fx-part=track]: Card row (children) — a height must be given (cards stand overlapping in the center)
options.[data-fx-part=item]: Card (child of the row) — the first child inside it is what tilts
options.[data-fx-part=dot]: Page indicator (optional) — is-current goes on the center card’s turn
options.step: Next-card position (card width %), default 55 — Brand phone 105
options.far: Outer section position (%), default 104.17 — 200 on phones
options.tilt: Tilt when flipping (deg), default 8 — at 0 there is no tilt
options.fx:change: Event the element fires when fully moved
